name: Gale Crater, Curiosity's traverse
note: 33 x 40 km region: the overlap of the USGS 1 m Gale DEM and the Mars Trek HiRISE mosaic, from Bradbury Landing to the boxwork on Mount Sharp. Stored as tiles of tileSize x tileSize cells; the app loads an 8 km window of full-resolution tiles around the walk and a coarse overview of the rest. width and height must be multiples of tileSize; change the bounds, width and height together and re-run `pnpm data`.
